This successive bail application filed under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C., the applicant - accused no. 1 Shivaji Shankar Nikade seeks the regular bail in connection with the FIR being I.CR No. 82 of 2019 registered with Dediapada Police Station, Dist.:
Rajpipla, for the offences punishable under Sections 406,409, 420 and 114 of Indian Penal Code read with Section 3 of Gujarat Protection of Interest of Depositors (Financial Establishment) Act, 2003.

As per the prosecution case, the applicant and co- accused lured the innocent people and by making false representation, giving false promise of high return on investments obtained huge amount from the investors and thereafter, they could not pay the invested amount of the poor and agricultural persons.

One of the agent i.e. the complainant lodged an FIR for the aforesaid offences, stating inter-alia that present applicant and other office bearers of M/s. Athrav 4 U Infra and Agro Limited, hatched the criminal conspiracy with the common object to cheat the investors and false promises of the high return on the investments being given, as a result, the persons named in the FIR invested huge amount in the financial establishment of the applicant and on maturity, the accused failed to keep their promise and fraudulently defaulted in making paying of the invested amount to the various persons, whereby, they have committed the offence of cheating, criminal breach of trust.

entities.text: Athrav 4 U Infra and Agro Limited
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
4. In the aforesaid facts, learned counsel Mr. Kapadia has stated that this Court vide order dated 22.07.2022 relegated the applicant to approach the Sessions Court and specifically observed that,
the court may consider the subsequent events i.e. granting bail to co-accused and there is no progress NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11872/2023 ORDER DATED: 20/07/2023 undefined in the trail proceedings.

He further submitted that, pursuant to the order, the applicant moved an application before the Special Court seeking regular bail, however, the court below without considering the observations made by this Court, straightway rejected the application vide its order dated 05.04.2023.

In these circumstances, Mr. Kapadia, learned counsel submitted that, the co-accused Ganesh Hajare, Mukesh Sundesha and Sachin Gosavi have been granted bail and therefore, on the ground of parity, the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
He further submitted that, there are two change circumstances after the passing of order passed by this Court.

The first one is that, the other co- accused, who happened to be the Director of the Company, have been enlarged on bail and second is that, the applicant is being the bar since 23.08.2019 and till date, the charge has not been framed and therefore, when chargesheet is filed and the further custody of the applicant is not necessary, keeping behind bar the applicant for indefinite period would violate the life and liberty of the applicant as enshrined under the Constitution of India.

5. Opposing the contentions, learned Additional Public Prosecutor Ms. Patel has submitted that the applicant is the mastermind of the alleged conspiracy and NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/11872/2023 ORDER DATED: 20/07/2023 undefined considering the gravity of the offence, the discretion may not be exercised.

6. Having heard the learned counsel for the respective parties and on perusal of the material placed on record, it appears that after rejection of earlier bail application, there is change circumstances on the factual aspect, as the co-accused have been considered by this Court.
The prosecution failed to show the stage of trial.
It is reported that, since 23.08.2019, the applicant is in judicial custody and presently, he is in jail at Mumbai.
The charge in the case is yet to frame by the trial Court.
The entire prosecution case is based on documentary evidence and now same is in the custody of the I.O..

In such circumstances, there is no possibility to conclude the trial in near future and therefore,

7. In the result, the application is allowed.
The authorities shall release the applicant if he is not required in connection with the any other offence.
If breach of any above condition is committed, the Sessions Judge concerned shall take appropriate action or issue warrant against the applicant.
The bail bond to be executed before the learned trial Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
